title: Blue Axolotl Highlighter by imLoffi
description: Makes the rare Blue Axolotl easy to spot! All regular axolotls are recolored red, while the rare Blue Axolotl is recolored green, so you can instantly identify it in large breeding farms. Gameplay remains unchanged.
body:
Have you ever spent hours breeding axolotls only to struggle to find the rare Blue Axolotl among a huge crowd of offspring? This resource pack was created to solve exactly that problem.

The Blue Axolotl is one of the rarest mobs in Minecraft, and obtaining one often requires a large breeding setup with dozens or even hundreds of axolotls. In large farms, it can be difficult to quickly identify whether a Blue Axolotl has appeared.

This pack improves visibility by recoloring all regular axolotl variants to red while changing the rare Blue Axolotl to green. As a result, the rare variant stands out immediately, making it much easier to spot during breeding sessions.

Features
All common axolotl variants are recolored red.
The rare Blue Axolotl is recolored green.
Makes breeding projects more convenient.
Helps quickly identify rare spawns in crowded farms.
Texture-only change; gameplay is completely unaffected.

If you're managing a massive breeding farm, this pack helps you find the rare variant at a glance.
